title.zh: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
title.en: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation

current_state.zh: 纽约总检察长 Letitia James 于2026年9月24日起诉 Polymarket 的美国运营商 QCX LLC，指控其未经许可经营赌博业务，寻求禁令、赔偿、三倍收益罚款及每项违规10万美元罚款，并涉及CFTC监管与州赌博法的冲突。
current_state.en: New York Attorney General Letitia James sued QCX LLC, Polymarket's US operator, on Sept. 24, 2026, alleging an unlicensed gambling business and seeking an injunction, restitution, disgorgement, triple-gain penalties, and $100,000-per-violation fines, amid conflict between CFTC regulation and state gambling laws.
